requirements.label: Performance
requirements.title: Performance

rule.manualCheck: Requirement is two semesters, not two courses. Confirm that two semesters of the listed ensembles are completed.

requirements.sourceText: Performance: Two semesters of one or more of the following: MUS 261 - Stony Brook Chorale 1 credit; MUS 262 - University Orchestra 1 credit; MUS 263 - University Wind Ensemble 0-1 credit; MUS 264 - Big Band Jazz Ensemble 1 credit; MUS 266 - Guitar Workshop 1 credit; MUS 267 - Small Jazz Ensemble Level 1 6 credits.; MUS 268 - Spirit of Stony Brook Athletic Band 0-2 credits; MUS 235 - Introduction to African Drumming 4 credits.; MUS 335 - Advanced African Drumming 4 credits.; MUS 271 - Camerata Singers 1 credit; MUS 391 - Chamber Music 1 credit

policies.sourceText: All courses offered for the minor must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher.
All courses offered for the minor must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher.

with.manualCheck: Lessons are counted as two semesters. The ensemble corequisite for private lessons is waived for minor students.

substitutions.condition: Students who do not pass the audition for one of the ensembles
substitutions.sourceText: With the permission of the director of undergraduate studies, students who do not pass the audition for one of the ensembles may fulfill the performance requirement through private lessons (MUS 161 -MUS 187 ). For students in the minor who fulfill the performance requirement through lessons, the ensemble corequisite for private lessons (MUS 161 -MUS 187 ) will be waived.

notes.text: The general Music minor (MUS) is for students who do not seek training in more sophisticated aspects of music theory and musicianship. The Music Theory minor (MTY) uses Music major courses in theory and musicianship.
Contact the Director of Undergraduate Studies, Deborah Heckert, for permission to fulfill the performance requirement through private lessons.
